mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record (user_id, type, category_id, amount, date, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{date}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.name as category_name, c.icon as category_icon FROM record r LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.*, c.name as category_name, c.icon as category_icon FROM record r LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.date >= #{startDate} AND r.date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY r.date DESC, r.create_time DESC
SELECT r.*, c.name as category_name, c.icon as category_icon FROM record r LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.date = #{date} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.date, SUM(CASE WHEN r.type = 1 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END) as income, SUM(CASE WHEN r.type = 2 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END) as expense, COUNT(*) as count, h.name as holiday_name, h.type as holiday_type FROM record r LEFT JOIN holiday h ON r.date = h.date WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.date >= #{startDate} AND r.date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY r.date, h.name, h.type ORDER BY r.date
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 1 AND date >= #{startDate} AND date <= #{endDate}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 2 AND date >= #{startDate} AND date <= #{endDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 1 AND date >= #{startDate} AND date <= #{endDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 2 AND date >= #{startDate} AND date <= #{endDate}

SELECT r.date, SUM(CASE WHEN r.type = 1 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END) as income, SUM(CASE WHEN r.type = 2 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END) as expense, COUNT(*) as count, h.name as holiday_name, h.type as holiday_type FROM record r LEFT JOIN holiday h ON r.date = h.date WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.date >= #{startDate} AND r.date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY r.date, h.name, h.type ORDER BY expense DESC LIMIT #{limit}
